**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Miss Smith](../persons.html#263)
I should have been glad to accept your ‘Manchester Visit’, but it has been forestalled as you will [see](../others.html#52) on the first of August.
I have put out [your princesses](../others.html#262) for October but I do not feel sure how the space will be[^2]

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

[^1]: With envelope addressed to Miss Anne Smith/ Stepney Rectory/ London and postmarked Winchester 29 July and on reverse 30 July 1857.

[^2]: ‘A Glimpse into a Royal Home Seventy Years Ago’ MP 14 (November 1857) 470-96.
